lines.text: He, she or it? The verb gets an s.
Not: She don't like crowded places.
Say: She doesn't like crowded places.
Watches! My father watches the news every evening.

quiz.stem: My father ___ the news every evening.

publish.title: Present Simple. One rule!
publish.value: Say "She doesn't like crowded places", not "She don't like crowded places".
